hits.title: The Mission Comes First - Cellebrite
hits.snippet: August 13, 2026 | Shiven (Shiv) Ramji, Cellebrite CEO Today, Cellebrite’s Board of Directors announced that I have been appointed Chief Executive Officer. It is an incredible honor to lead this company. I joined Cellebrite only a few months ago, but in that time I have spent countless hours with our people, our customers and our technology. And one thing became clear to me very quickly: the work we do matters. Every day, investigators, forensic examiners, intelligence professionals and public safety leaders around the world take on extraordinarily difficult work. They search for missing children. They investigate violent crimes. They defend nations. They protect businesses. They help bring truth to light and ensure justice can move forward. Our job at Cellebrite is to help them do that work better, faster and with greater confidence. That mission is what brought me here. And as CEO, it will remain at the center of everything we do. I also ... to thank Tom Hogan for his leadership of ... an exceptional leadership ... company and positioned us ... the next chapter. I am grateful for his partnership and for the trust he has placed in me.

hits.title: Shiven Ramji Joins Cellebrite as President of Products
hits.snippet: TYSONS CORNER, VA and PETAH TIKVA, ISRAEL – April 30, 2026 – Cellebrite DI Ltd. (Nasdaq: CLBT), a global leader in AI-powered Digital Investigative and Intelligence solutions, today announced the appointment of Shiven Ramji as President of Products and Technology. In this role, Ramji will lead the Company’s product and technology organization, driving innovation and execution of Cellebrite’s industry-leading Digital Investigative and Intelligence platform. Ramji will start on May 4, 2026 and succeed Ronnen Armon, who will be retiring in a few months after the transition is complete. ... “We are thrilled to welcome Shiv to Cellebrite. Shiv’s impressive track record, experience and expertise will be critical as we continue to accelerate the pace of AI adoption and innovation in our products to support our customers and deliver on our mission of protecting communities, nations and businesses,” said Thomas E. Hogan, CEO of Cellebrite. “I would like to thank Ronnen Armon for his leadership and many significant contributions to Cellebrite’s success over the last five years, including transforming the Company into an AI-first, market-leading public company.
